title: Separable residue extensions of finite products of tame root algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $m\in\mathbf N$, $f\in R$, and $e:\operatorname{Fin}(m)\to\mathbf N$ with every $e_i>0$ and $e_i$ a unit in $R$. Put $D=\prod_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(m)}R[T]/(T^{e_i}-f)$ and let $\pi:\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be induced by the diagonal coefficient map [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every $x\in\operatorname{Spec}D$, the canonical residue extension $\kappa(x)/\kappa(\pi(x))$ [def-weil-residue-field] is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. The zero ring and $m=0$ are allowed.

source.place: Tag 0EYH, displayed local normal form; elementary residue calculation for that form

proof.text: A point of the spectrum of the finite product selects exactly one factor; the empty product has no points. Write k for the residue field of its base point and t for the image of the root coordinate. The fibre of that factor is k[T]/(T^e-fbar). If fbar is zero, positivity of e gives t=0 in the residue field, so the residue field is k. Otherwise t is nonzero. The derivative e*T^(e-1) is nonzero at t because e is invertible. Hence the irreducible polynomial defining this point is separable. Its quotient field is the residue field of the point. These identifications use the canonical structure maps, so the same conclusion holds for the canonical map on scheme residue fields.

mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: separably closed field and separable-degree criteria, plus instIsSeparableResidueFieldOfQuotientIdeal and Algebra.isSeparable_residueField_iff. The latter require maximal ideals and already-separable quotient algebras; none gives the root-product calculation.

1 hit: over a field, X^n-a is separable when the casts of n and a are both nonzero. This covers only the nonzero fibre polynomial, not arbitrary base rings, products, or canonical scheme residue maps.

lean.statement:
theorem tameRootProduct_residue_separable (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (m : ℕ) (f : R) (e : Fin m → ℕ)
    (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : R)) :
    let D := CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
      AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f))
    let π : Spec D ⟶ Spec R :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R D))
    ∀ x : Spec D,
      letI := (π.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsSeparable ((Spec R).residueField (π x)) ((Spec D).residueField x)
